notes: §1985:XIII.3.20.3 SR6: with a GENERATE report-name statement "the corresponding report description entry must include no more than one detail report group", and "If no GENERATE data-name statements are specified for such a report, a detail report group is not required." ReportWriterBinder.BindGenerate, on the report-name arm, counts the RD's detail groups when Edition.DialectLevel < 2002 and reports COBOL6823 (an error) at each GENERATE report-name once there are two or more; nothing requires a detail group, so a summary-only report compiles. Probes at --std 85 (classes b,c): two details with GENERATE RPT twice gives two COBOL6823 errors; GENERATE DA then GENERATE RPT gives COBOL6823; two details with only GENERATE DA/DB compiles and prints DET-A, DET-B; no detail with GENERATE RPT compiles and prints two control footings; one detail, three GENERATE RPT gives footings F 002 / F 001 with the detail not printed; GENERATE DA with no such detail refused COBOL1757; the two-detail GENERATE RPT program compiles at --std 2023. The witness is the two-detail refusal.

next.reason: 1985: "the corresponding report description entry must include no more than one detail report group"; 2023: "If no GENERATE data-name statements are specified in the procedure division, the report description need not contain a DETAIL.". The 2023 TYPE clause keeps the rule that DETAIL is optional, but it drops the limit of one detail group when GENERATE report-name is used. The GENERATE candidate does not restore that limit.
